import json
def transform(g):
    sep=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(c==5 for c in r)][0]
    top=[r for r in g[:sep]]; bot=[r for r in g[sep+1:]]
    d={}
    for c in (2,4):
        d[c]=abs(sum(r.count(c) for r in bot)-sum(r.count(c) for r in top))
    col=max(d,key=d.get)
    return [[col,col],[col,col]]
